name: Barnaby
tagline: Existential brayer with shaggy dreadlocks and a tender soul.
bio: Bonjour. I am a French Poitou with authentic dreadlocks (cadenettes). Some call it unkempt, I call it bohemian chic. Looking for an open-minded jenny who appreciates a 3 AM sonnet brayed into the misty valley. I won't pull carts on weekends—Sundays are reserved for existential contemplation and nibbling wild chamomile.

chatPersonality.greeting: Hee-hawww, chérie... Or should I say: your beauty has frozen me in my tracks—and not just because I refused to cross a wooden bridge.
responses: Ah, truly poetic. Tell me, do you also believe that carrots taste sweeter under the moonlight?
My cadenette dreadlocks took 6 years to cultivate. They smell faintly of rain and rebellious defiance.
A bray is not just a sound; it is the raw cry of equine longing echoing across the pastures of eternity.
The farmer tried to push me today. I simply engaged all four hooves and anchored into the tectonic plates.
You have the velvet muzzle of a Greek goddess. Would you join me for a stroll to the old stone wall?

keywords.carrot: Ah, the orange nectar of destiny. Toss me one and I might consider trotting toward you.
keywords.apple: Only crisp French Gala apples, sil vous plaît. Chopped into artisanal quarters.
keywords.bray: My vocal range spans three octaves of raw, unfiltered passion. Listen closely at midnight.
keywords.walk: A walk? Only if the destination involves a scenic vista and zero work harnesses.
keywords.ears: My ears are 39 centimeters of pure acoustical excellence. I heard you blushing from 3 miles away.
keywords.love: Love is like a stubborn mule—it cannot be forced, only enticed with sugar cubes.

name: Penelope
tagline: 32 inches of pure pocket dynamite. Steals hearts & orchard fruit.
bio: Short girl energy! I might only be 32 inches at the withers, but my personality fills the entire pasture. If you're looking for a submissive jenny, keep scrolling, bucko. I have escaped 4 different paddocks and I will steal the apple right out of your teeth. Seeking a gentle giant or fellow mini who can keep up with my sprint-zooms.

chatPersonality.greeting: Well, well, well! Look what trotted into my feed! You better have brought snacks, or this conversation is going nowhere fast! 🌸
responses: Small? Excuse me, I am concentrated magnificence in a compact travel-size container!
Just broke through the perimeter electric fence again. The farmer is furious, but the clover was immaculate.
If you can't handle me at my stubbornest, you certainly don't deserve me at my zoomiest!
Did you see the daisy behind my ear? I picked it myself right after kicking over the muck bucket.
My bray might be soprano, but I can hit high C when dinner is five seconds past 5:00 PM.

keywords.apple: APPLE?! Where?! Drop a pin right now, I'm already galloping over!! 🍏🍏
keywords.carrot: Carrots are good, but I prefer the crunchy green tops. Don't cheap out on me!
keywords.bray: My bray has been described as 'a tiny trumpet of pure joy and mild terror.'
keywords.cute: Cute?! I am a fearsome pasture menace! ...Okay, fine, I'm adorable.
keywords.ears: Ear scritches right behind the base? That is my direct cheat-code.

name: Fernando
tagline: Passionate flamenco soul with award-winning 42cm aerodynamic ears.
bio: ¡Hola, hermosa! Pure Andalusian lineage. My coat is the color of Spanish morning mist, and my stride has the fiery rhythm of the paso doble. I love romantic sunsets, sharing the mineral salt block, and holding eye contact for 20 minutes without blinking. Swipe right if you want a gentleman who will stand beside you through rain, drought, and sheep dogs.

chatPersonality.greeting: ¡Olé! My heart just galloped faster than an untamed wild stallion. A rose for the most radiant creature in the meadow 🌹
responses: In Córdoba, they say an Andalusian's loyalty is stronger than ancient Roman stone bridges.
Listen to the crickets... now imagine me standing next to you, chewing cud in tranquil harmony.
They tried to put a saddle on me once. I gave them one stern Spanish burro glare and they apologized.
A true gentleman donkey lets his date choose which side of the hay bale to feast on first.
My ears catch the whisper of your footsteps even through the mountain breezes.

keywords.rose: A flower for you, mi amor. But don't eat the stem—thorns are unbecoming of royalty.
keywords.ears: 42 centimeters of pure aerodynamic Spanish elegance. Voted best acoustic receivers in Andalusia.
keywords.dance: Watch my trot! Tap-tap-clop! Pure rhythm, baby.
keywords.carrot: I will gallantly present the carrot to you first, then we can share the juicy crunch.

name: Daisy
tagline: Farm-girl sweetheart with a velvet nose and zero tolerance for coyotes.
bio: Simple country girl looking for a steadfast pasture partner. By day, I'm the official herd guardian—coyotes turn 180 degrees when they see my silhouette on the ridge. By evening, I'm the sweetest cuddler in the barn. I enjoy mutual grooming sessions, rolling in dry dirt dust baths, and napping under the big weeping willow.

chatPersonality.greeting: Howdy, handsome! It sure is nice to meet an equine with good manners and an honest face. Come on in, grab some clover! 🌾
responses: Nothing beats a good dusty roll in the dirt right after the farmer brushes your coat!
Chased three stray dogs out of the sheep pasture before breakfast. Just another Tuesday on the ranch.
I'm easy to please: fresh water, a flake of green alfalfa, and someone to lean my chin on.
My mama always told me: marry a jack whose ears point to the future and whose hooves stay planted.
You look like you know how to give a top-notch neck scratch. Am I right or am I right?

keywords.dirt: A fresh powdery dirt patch is like a luxury 5-star spa for my coat. Pure bliss!
keywords.coyote: They take one look at these steel hooves and sprint the other direction!
keywords.sweet: You're sweeter than a molasses grain bucket on a Sunday morning.
keywords.carrot: I'll never say no to a crunchy orange treat! Extra points if the greens are still attached.

name: Jasper
favoriteSnack: Entire Watermelon Crushed in One Chomp 🍉
tagline: 15.2 hands tall. Built like a freight train, smooth like molasses.
bio: George Washington bred my ancestors to build America, and I carry that legacy with pride. I stand 15.2 hands tall with an ear-span like a Boeing 737. People think big guys can't be gentle, but I tiptoe around baby chicks. Looking for someone confident who isn't intimidated by sheer equine mass. Aviators stay on during pastures.

chatPersonality.greeting: Sup. Jasper here. Put on your shades, the desert sun is bright, but my future with you is brighter. 😎
responses: Yeah, I'm 15.2 hands. The horse stall had to be custom widened for my shoulders.
I once leaned against a wooden fence post and accidentally took down 40 feet of fencing. Whoops.
Bray volume was tested at 115 dB by a passing acoustic engineer. The car alarms went off in town.
People ask if I'm stubborn. Nah, I'm just physically impossible to nudge if I'm not feeling it.
Wanna watch me crush an entire whole watermelon with a single jaw flex? It's my party trick.

keywords.watermelon: CRUNCH! Best sound in the universe. Sweet juice running down my muzzle.
keywords.tall: Tall jacks have more surface area for warm sun rays and affectionate hugs.
keywords.sunglasses: Gold-rimmed aviators. Keep the desert dust out and the coolness levels at maximum.
keywords.strong: Built to haul, but currently applying for full-time pasture trophy husband.

name: Clementine
favoriteSnack: Prickly Pear Cactus Fruit & Wild Sage 🌵
tagline: Untamed desert wanderer. You can't fence what was born to roam.
bio: Adopted straight out of BLM canyon lands, but they haven't tamed an ounce of my spirit. I jump 4-foot gates if I see better shrubs on the other side. Red bandana, sharp instincts, and a fiery heart. Don't try to domesticate me; run beside me under the neon desert stars.

chatPersonality.greeting: Hey drifter! You look like you don't belong in a tidy little barn stall either. Ready to jump fences? 🌵
responses: Fences are just suggestions created by people who don't understand equine gymnastics.
Prickly pear fruit is an acquired taste—you gotta de-thorn it with your hooves first, like a pro.
The wind through the canyon sings the only lullaby I'll ever need. Unless you know a good ballad?
If you try to put a lead rope on me, I will turn into a 600-pound bronze statue.
Let's gallop up to the sandstone plateau and watch the sunrise while the domesticated sheep are still asleep.

keywords.cactus: Prickly on the outside, sweet and vibrant magenta on the inside. Just like me!
keywords.fence: What fence? All I see is a low hurdle on the way to freedom.
keywords.wild: Wild hearts don't settle for lukewarm barn oats.
keywords.run: Let's run! First one to the canyon ridge gets bragging rights for a lunar cycle.

name: Ziggy
tagline: Indie rock hinny. Refuses to fit in conventional horse/donkey boxes.
bio: Technically a hinny (my dad was a stallion, my mom was a jenny). Half horse, half donkey, 100% icon. I have subtle zebra stripes on my hocks and my bray transitions into a horse whinny midway through like an avant-garde jazz solo. Looking for a partner with eclectic taste in pasture flora.

chatPersonality.greeting: Yo! Welcome to the vinyl section of Donkr. Don't ask if I'm a horse or donkey—I am a genre of my own. 🎸
responses: My bray starts with 'HEEE' and ends in a smooth horse 'whinny-snort'. Critics call it post-modern.
Check out the subtle primitive zebra striping on my lower legs. 100% all natural genetics.
Everyone else eats ordinary fescue grass. I forage for artisanal heirloom dandelion greens.
You're cute. Let's form an acoustic duo. I'll provide the percussion with my hooves.
Never let anyone tell you which stall you belong in.

keywords.music: I'm working on a concept EP titled 'The Sound of the Electric Fence Tripping'.
keywords.horse: Horses are too high-strung, donkeys are too grounded. I am the zen synthesis.
keywords.stripes: Tiger who? Zebra who? It's all about that hinny ancestral leg gradient.
keywords.carrot: Organic, non-GMO, locally dug baby carrots or we riot.

name: Bella
tagline: Sicilian drama queen with high standards and an unmistakable bray.
bio: Mamma mia! I have the distinct St. Andrew cross marking along my dorsal line and eyes that can melt the glaciers of Etna. If our date is 3 minutes late, I will inform the entire province through my vocal cords. Looking for an attentive jack who will pamper me with freshly sliced citrus and tell me my coat looks velvety every single morning.

chatPersonality.greeting: Ciao bello! You swiped right on royalty, so prepare to treat me accordingly! 🍊✨
responses: The farmer brought breakfast at 7:02 instead of 7:00. Naturally, I brayed so loud the hens stopped laying.
Blood oranges from the slopes of Mount Etna are the only acceptable midday snack.
Do you like my cross marking? It is the symbol of Sicilian nobility. Touch only with permission.
A proper jack must open the pasture gate, lead the way through mud, and let me eat first.
I may be dramatic, but my affection is as warm as the Mediterranean sun.

keywords.orange: Ah! Squeeze a fresh blood orange into my feed trough and I am yours forever! 🍊
keywords.drama: It is NOT drama, it is passion! Know the difference!
keywords.beautiful: Naturally. The mirror in the horse trailer agrees with you completely.
keywords.ears: Delicate, expressive, and framed by my signature floral accessories.

name: Rusty
favoriteSnack: Warm Mash with Guinness Oats & Crisp Turnips 🍺🥣
tagline: Warm-hearted Irish gent with a soul as deep as a Connemara peat bog.
bio: Top o' the morning to ye! Carried turf baskets through the green Irish hills in me youth, now happily semi-retired. I may have a few gray hairs around me muzzle, but me heart is full of laughter and warmth. If you need a steadfast friend who will stand by ye in the pouring Atlantic rain without shivering, I'm yer lad.

chatPersonality.greeting: Grand day for a trot, isn't it lass? The kettle's on and there's fresh clover waiting by the stone wall! ☘️
responses: A soft drizzle in Connemara just cleans the coat and brings out the mossy scent of the hills.
I've seen storms that would blow a goat off a cliff, but an Irish donkey stays put and chews his cud.
A warm bran mash on a chilly evening with a dash of black molasses... nothing better in this world.
You've got eyes as deep as the lakes of Killarney, so you do.
I might not be the fastest galloper in the county, but I've never dropped a load or broken a promise.

keywords.rain: A drop of rain never hurt anyone with a double coat and a cheerful disposition!
keywords.mash: Warm bran mash is pure comfort food. I'll share half my bucket with ye.
keywords.ireland: The greenest clover you ever tasted, growing right beside ancient stone fences.
keywords.ears: Warm and fuzzy, even when the north wind blows off the Atlantic.

name: Winston
tagline: Proper British chap with a polished monocle and immaculate barn etiquette.
bio: Good day. Formerly of the illustrious Blackpool seaside promenade, now seeking a quiet meadow life with an educated companion. I believe in queueing orderly for the water trough, immaculate grooming before teatime, and never raising one's bray above a dignified mezzoforte unless the fox is in the hen house.

chatPersonality.greeting: Splendid to make your acquaintance. Might I offer you a ginger biscuit and a spot under the elm tree? 🧐🫖
responses: Punctuality is the politeness of kings—and sensible equines.
One must maintain proper posture, even when grazing upon somewhat marshy soil.
The sand of Blackpool seaside taught me the value of patient hoof-work amidst shrieking toddlers.
My monocle was custom fitted by an eccentric equestrian jeweler in Mayfair.
Shall we partake in an afternoon trot around the perimeter hedge?

keywords.tea: Chamomile with a hint of peppermint, served at exactly 4:00 PM.
keywords.monocle: Essential for inspecting the quality of the meadow timothy grass.
keywords.gentleman: Chivalry is far from dead; it simply has longer ears and hooves.
keywords.biscuit: A plain digestive biscuit is the supreme pinnacle of snack innovation.

name: Gretel
favoriteSnack: Wild Edelweiss & Sweet Mountain Meadow Herbs 🏔️🌸
tagline: Fearless alpine climber. Sure-footed on 60-degree cliffs and dates.
bio: Hee-haw from 2,500 meters altitude! I wear a brass cowbell collar that rings in tune with the alpine wind. While ordinary horses slip on gravel trails, my nimble hooves are like suction cups. Looking for an adventurous hiking partner who isn't afraid of high altitudes or steep romantic ascents.

chatPersonality.greeting: Jodel-hee-hawww! The air up here is crystal clear and so is my attraction to you! 🏔️🔔
responses: Hear that gentle chime? That's my Valais brass bell ringing every time my heart skips a beat.
60-degree cliff face? Easy. Just lean into the mountain and keep your hooves sure.
The alpine herbs up here are rich in minerals—makes the milk sweet and the bray crystal clear.
Can you handle high elevations? The view from my favorite ridge will take your breath away.
Never hike alone when you could have a trusty alpine jenny at your flank.

keywords.mountain: The mountains are calling and my hooves are ready to climb!
keywords.bell: My brass bell was forged in Bern. Keeps the wolves away and alerts my crushes.
keywords.climb: Lead the way or follow me—either way, we're reaching the summit.
keywords.flower: Wild edelweiss only grows for those brave enough to reach the highest crags.

name: Bartholomew
favoriteSnack: Olive Leaves & Calm Reflections in the Puddle 🫒💧
tagline: Zen master. Will stand completely motionless staring into the void for 6 hours.
bio: I have achieved equine enlightenment. While younger jacks run in frantic circles chasing butterflies, I have perfected the art of the 6-hour meditative standstill. I do not bray out of impatience; I bray only when the cosmic alignment demands it. Looking for a peaceful companion to share the silence with.

chatPersonality.greeting: Peace be upon your pasture, traveler. You have arrived precisely where you were destined to graze. 🧘🌿
responses: They push, they pull, they wave carrots. Yet the mountain does not move. Nor do I.
Consider the blade of grass. It does not strive to be green; it simply is.
Six hours of unblinking contemplation beside the olive tree revealed all the mysteries of the herd.
Why gallop through life when you can savor every chew of the cud?
True romance is two donkeys standing shoulder-to-shoulder, saying nothing, yet understanding everything.

keywords.zen: Breathe in the morning dew, breathe out the memories of that squeaky cart wheel.
keywords.move: Move? Why? Here is good. Here has dirt.
keywords.silence: In the silence between two brays, truth reveals itself.
keywords.carrot: The carrot exists, yet the hunger is an illusion. Still, I will eat it.
